subject: Joint Pilot Roadmap: milestones, decision timeline & owners
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <m.lopez@acadiahealth.com>, Jason Ellis <j.ellis@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Joint Pilot Roadmap: milestones, decision timeline & owners

Hi Marta / Jason —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard and the joint pilot roadmap I promised to put down in writing. Let me know if I missed anything or if dates need adjusting.

Key pain & goals we captured:
- High latency and cost for document ingest and retrieval workflows — impacts clinician triage speed.
- Need strict data isolation and auditability for PHI handling.
- Goal: reduce triage time by 25% on average and validate safe redaction for PHI before production.

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks):
1) Week 1 (7/21–7/25): Data onboarding + sample ingestion (non-PHI subset) — owners: Acadia (Jason) / Redwood eng (Ben)
2) Week 2 (7/28–8/1): Latency & throughput tuning, baseline metrics capture — owners: Redwood eng (Ben)
3) Week 3 (8/4–8/8): PHI-safe redaction test and compliance audit runbook — owners: Acadia security (Marta) / Redwood security (Marissa)
4) Week 4 (8/11–8/15): Acceptance run, decision checkpoint — owner: Acadia exec sponsor (Jason)

Decision process and dates:
- Internal Acadia decision meeting scheduled: target decision-by date 8/22/2025 (Jason to confirm sponsor availability).
- If pilot acceptance criteria met (latency, redaction pass, cost targets), proposed next step: Dedicated Reserved Capacity pilot (contract & SOW) to be negotiated in Aug–Sep.

Open items / asks from Acadia:
- Confirm exec sponsor who will sign off on acceptance criteria (Jason?)
- Provide initial dataset drop (see attached sample list) by 7/24
- Procurement contact to start POC paperwork (cc procurement@acadiahealth.com)

Attachments: acadia_mpa_v1.xlsx (living MPA with milestones) and pilot_scope_onepager.pdf (one-pager for your leadership).

Proposed next meeting: 7/28 10:00–10:45 PT (to review Week 2 tuning plan). If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marta Lopez <m.lopez@acadiahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Jason Ellis <j.ellis@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acadiahealth.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 17:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Pilot Roadmap: milestones, decision timeline & owners

Thanks Rachel — this is very helpful and close to what we discussed. A couple of quick clarifications: 
- Week 1 dataset: we can share a de-identified batch by 7/24; full (PHI) dataset will need our legal/compliance OK before we hand it over for Week 3 testing.
- Exec sponsor: I’ll confirm Jason as the sponsor but we’ll need a brief pre-check with our CIO (Elaine Park) the week of 8/4 — does Redwood have a short leadership one-pager?

On procurement: procurement@acadiahealth.com is the right inbox; I’ve asked them to pick up the POC paperwork next week.

Two small timeline asks from our side:
1) Can the acceptance checkpoint slide include the redaction pass/fail criteria explicitly?
2) We prefer the decision-by date to be 8/25 (end of week) rather than 8/22 to allow CIO review.

If you can update the MPA with those two notes and send over a 1-page leadership summary for Elaine, I’ll take both to procurement and the CIO.

Best,
Marta
Head of Security & Privacy, Acadia Health
m.lopez@acadiahealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0987

- Acceptance checkpoint now explicitly lists redaction pass criteria (redaction recall > 95%, no false redaction of clinical terms, audit log completeness).
- Decision-by date moved to 2025-08-25 per Acadia preference.
- Added a line item for Redwood to prepare a short leadership one-pager for CIO review (attached).
